---
name: Feature request
about: An outcome you want LilOS to have
title: ""
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

**Outcome** (what you want to be able to do, in product terms — not the code
change)

**Acceptance criteria** (optional but helpful — how would you see it works?)

**Agent tools** (which `lilos_*` tools let an employee use this; or why it's
not agent-facing — see "Agent Gateway" in `AGENTS.md`)

**For agent slices**: a feature is split into vertical slices; each slice
with acceptance criteria + a verify plan gets the `agent-ready` label so a
coding agent can take it — see the work-tracking rules in `AGENTS.md`.
